reference_excerpts.value: 1927年，李书田应北洋大学校长刘仙洲之邀返校任教，讲授土木工程专业的课程，开始了他长达近60年的教育生涯。李书田重视教学与科研相结合，除了在北洋任教外，还担任华北水利委员会的委员兼秘书长一职。1930年，李书田到交通大学唐山土木工程学院任院长，到校不及一年就为该校添设了矿冶工程系和研究院，促进了唐山地区的科研事业。1931年4月，在李书田的努力下，中国水利工程学会得以建立，他任该学会副会长。1932年9月，李书田任北洋工学院（北洋大学当时的校名）院长。此后5年间，他为学校发展做了大量卓有成效的工作：学校的工程学馆、工程实验馆、新图书馆相继竣工并投入使用；学校多种学术期刊蓬勃发展；重新创作了校歌；各系增设了近20个实验室，增添了设备；1935年，学校创办“工科研究所”，开创了研究生培养的先河，使北洋工学院成为国内高校中最早招收研究生的大学之一；他力促建成了“天津水工实验所”，后改称“中国第一水工实验所”。1937年2月，李书田制定了《国立北洋大学筹备缘起及分期完成计划》，提出了用16年时间，将北洋大学建设成为工理文法医相结合的综合性一流大学的奋斗目标。

reference_excerpts.value: The layout of the Students’ Dormitory Buildings at Peiyangyuan Campus is designed with a focus on student welfare. The 24 enclosed buildings are strategically located around academic facilities and near dining halls, supermarkets, and other essential services, housing approximately 20,000 students. The dormitory buildings form a courtyard that encloses all four sides. The names of each building—Ge Yuan, Zhi Yuan （知园） , Cheng Yuan, Zheng Yuan, Xiu Yuan, Qi Yuan, Zhi Yuan （治园） , and Ping Yuan—are derived from the eight steps for self-perfection as outlined in The Book of Rites and The Great Learning . These steps include learning from nature (gewu), pursuing the truth (zhizhi), remaining honest to one’s heart (chengyi), practicing temperance (zhengxin), perfecting one’s personality (xiushen), harmonizing one’s family (qijia), managing one’s country (zhiguo), and restoring peace to the world (pingtianxia).

（一）公安出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，符合签发条件的应当在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或需异地核查材料等特殊情况，不能按期签发的，经省级公安机关出入境管理机构负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日。
答：一般情况下，内地公安机关出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，会在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或者需要进一步调查核实等情况，不能按期签发的，经审批机关负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日；台湾居民因探病、奔丧、诉讼、处理紧急商务等事由急于返回台湾的，公安机关出入境管理机构将加急办理。一般情况下，口岸公安机关出入境管理机构办理台湾居民来往大陆通行证不超过30分钟。
温馨提示：国庆节期间，交通出行压力巨大，请大家提前做好规划，尽量不去人多的地方，注意人身财产安全！

Foreigners who need to stay in China after the expiration of residence permits shall apply for an extension 30 days before the expiration. transport.value:
中国实行右侧通行，机动车驾驶位在左侧。行人需在人行道内行走，电动自行车、电动三轮车等需登记后方可上路行驶。乘坐公共交通时，公交车遵循 “前门上车、后门下车” 规则，地铁内禁止大声喧哗和饮食。建议通过《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法》官网查询详细规定。​
（一）公安出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，符合签发条件的应当在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或需异地核查材料等特殊情况，不能按期签发的，经省级公安机关出入境管理机构负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日。
答：一般情况下，内地公安机关出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，会在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或者需要进一步调查核实等情况，不能按期签发的，经审批机关负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日；台湾居民因探病、奔丧、诉讼、处理紧急商务等事由急于返回台湾的，公安机关出入境管理机构将加急办理。一般情况下，口岸公安机关出入境管理机构办理台湾居民来往大陆通行证不超过30分钟。

答：一般情况下，内地公安机关出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，会在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或者需要进一步调查核实等情况，不能按期签发的，经审批机关负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日；台湾居民因探病、奔丧、诉讼、处理紧急商务等事由急于返回台湾的，公安机关出入境管理机构将加急办理。一般情况下，口岸公安机关出入境管理机构办理台湾居民来往大陆通行证不超过30分钟。

insurance.value:
National Health Insurance 2,000 yen
All foreign nationals with a residence permit for a period exceeding 3 months who are students or who are not covered by an employer’s social security plan (mutual aid, health insurance) are required to join National Health Insurance. By paying monthly premiums, subscribers are required to cover only 30% of their medical expenses.
National Health Insurance is especially beneficial in cases of serious disease or hospitalization thanks to its reimbursement system: if the total sum of medical bills that a single medical institution charges to a subscriber within 1 month exceeds a certain amount, the excess sum is reimbursed to the subscriber.

housing.value:
一、学历生及语言生必须在报到注册的当天支付来华留学生保险费，线上提交缴费凭证，才能完成报到手续；需缴纳学费及住宿费的学生，请于2026年9月8日前完成支付。未按照要求在规定时间内交纳学费及住宿费者予以退学并取消学籍。
B类：涵盖学费、住宿费及综合医疗保险费。 C类：涵盖学费及综合医疗保险费。
座谈会上，国际学生代表结合自身在校学习生活实际，围绕住宿管理、学业发展、奖助服务、校园文化活动、实习就业、毕业离校等重点事项，积极反馈现存问题、主动建言献策，为学院精准改进管理服务、补齐工作短板提供了宝贵参考依据。
与会教师对照学校规章制度、结合办学实际与现有资源，对学生提出的疑问和建议逐一细致回应、逐条答疑说明，并明确后续优化举措。学院将积极联动有关职能部门及相关培养学院，持续优化住宿管理模式，统筹兼顾校园安全规范与人文暖心服务；整合优质教学资源，丰富学术交流平台，助力学生夯实学业基础、提升专业能力；不断丰富校园文体活动，细化实习就业帮扶举措，完善校园配套保障，全方位提升国际学生在校学习生活体验。

living_costs.value:
International students are required to show tuition for 2 academic semesters +  estimated living expenses of $15,000 + $8700 in estimated fees for books,  health insurance and supplies etc. To determine your estimated fees:
Regardless of whether you live on campus or off  campus, you will have living expenses. This includes rent, utilities,  groceries, etc.    Living expenses are currently estimated at $15,000.00 per year. This sum must be added to the tuition and fees listed at https://bursar.temple.edu/tuition-and-fees/tuition-rates .
If you have a friend or family member who will be supplying room and board, they can complete the form available at https://isss.temple.edu/file/room-and-board-affidavitpdf. That form should be uploaded  and will  cover the estimated living expenses of $15,00.00. You would be responsible for provided financial documentation that covered the tuition and the estimated fees for  books, insuract etc which are set at $4,000.00

transport.value:
If you need to travel between campuses, UQ offers a free shuttle bus service that connects our St Lucia and Gatton campuses.
You can catch the free UQ Intercampus bus from the St Lucia campus – Chancellors Place, to the Gatton campus (runs four times per day Monday to Friday only). You must book a seat at least one (1) business day before your journey, using your UQ Student ID number as reference. Please refer to the current UQ Intercampus Bus Timetable when planning your journey (refer to the West Bound, St Lucia to Gatton service when travelling to Gatton).

housing.value:
SFSU has a variety of housing communities, room types and meal plans for you to choose from. Whatever you’re looking for, we have a space that’s right for you.
Ready to apply? Click the link below to learn about the application process, important application dates and deadlines, and to find answers to housing application FAQs.
Whether you prefer traditional residence hall, suite, or apartment-style housing, SFSU has a variety of housing communities and room types. Whatever you’re looking for, we have a space that’s right for you.
Curious about what it’s really like to live on campus? In-person housing tours will be available this summer for students attending orientation and throughout the year as part of the main campus tour. These tours will give you the chance to explore the inside of select communities and ask any questions you may have. There’s no better way to picture your future home away from home.

housing_costs.value:
All housing and meal plan fees are subject to change. Download Acrobat Reader to view PDF files.
As a benefit of living on campus, residents will have $100,000 in liability insurance provided for them through SF State and GradGuard. This liability coverage is included in your housing fees and protects you financially in the event you cause unintentional damage to your room or apartment due to fire, smoke, explosion, or the discharge of a sprinkler head.
To cancel a housing application or decline a space prior to the fee period, applicants are required to provide a 15-day cancellation notice in order to receive a refund of the initial payment. Applicants who have not yet submitted the initial payment may cancel at any time.
Find your new home! Before you apply, take a virtual tour of our residential community and explore our available housing options. Once you've identified your preferred community and room type, review the associated housing fees and meal plan requirements for your selected community.

Located on the Seoul campus, Sameuiwon is a newly renovated dormitory complex that can accommodate 392 students. Both Korean and international students may opt to live in this dormitory. The rooms are equipped with beds, desks, cabinets, air conditioners, LAN, and land phones for the comfort of students. Generally four students share each room.
There are many off-campus housing options in close proximity to the campuses. For more information regarding finding and securing off-campus housing, please contact the Center for International Students and Scholars.

We are still taking accommodation applications for September 2026. Invitation emails will continue to be sent. Please take the time to look at our halls and application information.
Accommodation is still available in university-managed or approved accommodation. Please submit your accommodation application via the accommodation portal by 2 September 2026 to be allocated accommodation on 4 September 2026. Allocation is subject to the applicant holding an unconditional offer to study by 2 September.
Did you know that everyone coming to study full-time at Oxford Brookes can apply for our halls? We guarantee accommodation for students who make us their firm choice and apply by the deadline.
Run by elected students, for students, the students’ union is here to help with a range of issues including finance, academic and housing. They will also help you join or set up a student group and run events.

The opening of Suffolk's sixth residence hall represents an exciting new chapter for both students and downtown Boston.
Your studies and college life in Boston extend well beyond the classroom thanks to our downtown location. As a Suffolk student, you'll have the best of both university and city worlds right outside your door, with on-campus dining, University housing, and student services, as well as all the sights, sounds, and excitement of a major downtown hub. Boston's arts and entertainment scene, diverse cuisine, history, public transportation, and more will form the dynamic backdrop of your college experience.
University Housing Visit Off Campus Housing Summer Housing Dining Options Student Resources
Suffolk University offers resources for students searching for off-campus housing. We can help you get started with finding a roommate and available housing in the Boston area. You can also contact us if you have any additional questions.

Dirección de Relaciones Internacionales
Es una unidad adscrita a la Rectoría cuya misión es manejar las relaciones con universidades del exterior, organismos y agencias internacionales, así como la promoción, planificación, coordinación, seguimiento y evaluación de planes, programas y proyectos de cooperación internacional con miras a potenciar la calidad de la docencia, la investigación y la extensión de la UTP.
Para cumplir con esta misión, la
Dirección de Relaciones Internacionales (DRI)
gestiona convenios internacionales que son utilizados como marco de acción conjunta entre las unidades internas y los socios internacionales.

housing.value:
Affordability is a key factor in choosing a university. UW-Stout Polytechnic is ranked as one of the United States' most affordable public universities. Be sure to compare apples to apples when considering other schools, and examine factors such as what your tuition and residence hall fees include, on-campus employment, internships, and scholarships .
At UW-Stout Polytechnic, we provide on-campus employment opportunities and paid internships with our industry partners. As an on-campus, undergraduate student your tuition and residence hall fees include textbooks, a laptop with software, and all of the essentials for your room. Plus, we have thousands of dollars in scholarships set aside specifically for international students.
Housing staff is available by phone or video chat (on Microsoft Teams) Monday-Friday, 8:00am - 4:30pm
Many international students live and eat on campus. The housing contract reserves your room and meal plan for the school year, and you can also choose to live on campus during the summer ( no summer meal plan available ). Suite-style housing may be available on campus. On-campus graduate housing is most likely not available.  For some students choosing to live off campus, costs are similar, depending upon the type of apartment or shared house.

This policy states that students are required to live on-campus their first two years after high school graduation. Review the policies and procedures, including the details of the Housing Contract and the Code of Conduct, that affect students living on-campus.

アンペロス寮

部屋数 ： 316室（男性用・女性用）
– １人部屋・２人部屋があります。

種別
名称
保証内容等
A
学生教育研究災害
傷害保険
死亡･後遺障害 1,000万円～2,000万円

入院加算 4,000円
（学内･通学途中・課外活動のみ適用）

外国人留学生向け
学研災付帯学生生活
総合保険
賠償責任保険：1億円（5000万円）
死亡・後遺傷害：100万円（100万円）
救援者費用：300万円（100万円）

C
国民健康保険
医療機関で支払う額の70％を保障
約2,000円／月
A、Bの費用は、上記納入金（実験実習費）に含まれます。
Cは、渡日後、留学生本人が役所で手続きをし、月額約2,000円の保険料を別途納付する必要があります。
※上記に加え、母国での海外旅行保険への加入を強く勧めます。
空港から大学まで
長崎への到着日には本学の職員が空港（福岡空港）

reference_excerpts.value: このプログラムは、長崎外国語大学の国際交流協定校に在籍している学生を対象として、半年から最大1年間の短期留学プログラムです。 短期留学プログラムは、JASINプログラム(Japan Studies in Nagasaki)とNICSプログラム（Nagasaki International Communication Studies）の2つのプログラムから構成されています。 JASINプログラムは、北米やヨーロッパ地域にある協定校に在籍している学生を対象としています。日本語を知らない人から日本語能力が中級者まで、あらゆるレベルの学生に、主に英語を使用した授業を提供しています。 NICSプログラムは、アジア地域にある協定校に在籍している学生を対象としています。日本語能力が、少なくとも中級レベル以上の学生に、主に日本語を使用した授業を提供しています。 どちらも、修得した単位を、帰国後に、協定校の規定に従い単位互換ができます。 また、いわゆる３+１プログラムも、この短期留学プログラムに1年間在籍することで、対応しています。ただし、長崎外国語大学の学位は、授与されません。

reference_excerpts.value: 本学のアンペロス寮は、キャンパスに隣接し通学に便利です。入寮を希望する人は直接アンペロス寮に問い合わせてください。（Tel：095-881-3100）。寮の詳細については「アンペロス寮インフォメーションガイド」をよく読んでください。 アンペロスとはギリシャ語で「ぶどうの樹」という意味です。 「わたしはぶどうの木、あたたがたはその枝である。人がわたしにつながっており、わたしもその人につながっていれば、その人は豊かに実を結ぶ。」（ヨハネによる福音書15章5節）というイエス・キリストの言葉にちなんだ名前です。寮生がキリストにつながり、豊かで実りのある生活を送れるようにという願いが込められています。 長崎外国語大学は、「世界がキャンパス！キャンパスが世界！」をモットーに世界を舞台に活躍できるグローバル人材の育成に取り組んでいます。この方針に基づき、世界各地から集った学生が共同生活を通して友好を深め、国際社会に通用する高度なコミュニケーション力と豊かな人間性を身に付けるための施設としてアンペロス寮を設置しています。

材料复合新技术国际联合实验室（国家国际联合研究中心）
发布：2023-11-07
分享
材料复合新技术国际联合实验室是科技部、国家外专局于
2007
年首批批准的
33
个国家国际科技合作重点科研机构之一，依托单位为武汉理工大学，实验室主任为中国工程院院士傅正义教授。
国际联合实验室瞄准世界材料科学前沿和国家重大需求，构建国际一流水平的材料复合与制备技术平台，研制国家重大工程和支柱产业发展需要的先进复合材料，为国家战略提供支撑；在变革性技术和前沿新材料及其交叉领域，产生具有国际影响力的原创性和系统性研究成果，在若干战略性前沿新材料研究方面引领国际发展；以卓越科学研究引领材料科学与工程世界一流学科的拔尖创新人才培养；营造国际协同创新文化，开展“强－强”国际合作研究，增强实验室的国际影响力、吸引力和凝聚力。
国际联合实验室以创建和发展材料多组分、多尺度、多层次复合原理与材料设计理论为重要引领，以构建材料梯度复合技术、原位复合技术、纳米复合技术及其集成创新平台为核心支撑，以研究面向国家重大工程和支柱产业的先进复合材料、面向新能源技术的高效能源转换和储存材料、面向生命科学的纳米复合生物材料、面向信息技术的信息功能材料和面向变革性技术的前沿新材料等五类关键材料为重大任务，形成了如下特色鲜明的五个研究方向：梯度复合技术与新材料、原位复合技术与新材料、纳米复合技术与新材料、变革性技术与前沿新材料、材料复合原理与材料设计。
国际联合实验室现有固
定人员100名，其中包括领军科学家两院院士3人，发达国家院士3人；国家级高层次人才24人，国家级 “四青”人才29人；英国皇家化学会会士、美国物理学会会士、美国陶瓷学会会士10人，汤森路透和科睿唯安 “全球高被引科学家”4人；来自国际著名大学和研究机构的外方研究人员26人。
国际联合实验室与美国密歇根大学、日本航空宇宙技术开发机构、日本东北大学金属材料研究所、英国牛津大学材料研究中心、美国加州大学复合材料研究中心、加拿大燃料电池国家研究院等国际著名研究机构开展了实质性的“强—强”合作。国家外专局和教育部依托实验室建立了“材料复合新技术与先进功能材料”、“功能薄膜新材料先进制备技术与应用工程”和“生命复合材料学科创新引智基地”等3个学科创新引智基地，依托这些重要的国际合作平台，实验室承担了一批国家重点国际合作项目，国际合作与交流取得了丰硕的成果。
在
2014
年和
2020
年国家首次、第二次国际联合实验室评估中，实验室都被评估为优秀。国际联合实验室已经成为在国际材料科学技术领域具有重要影响的国际合作研究、学术交流和拔尖创新人才合作培养的基地。

分享
2017年9月，根据教育部关于“转化医学与临床研究”等国际合作联合实验室立项建设的通知（教技函〔2017〕52号），我校材料复合新技术与新材料国际合作联合实验室获准立项建设。
材料复合新技术与新材料国际合作联合实验室依托材料复合新技术国家重点实验室，选择美国加州大学欧文分校和日本东北大学等高校和研究机构为主要的合作伙伴，通过深度联合，共同打造材料复合新技术与新材料技术研发平台，吸引对方国家和其他国家的优秀人才到中国开展合作研究和共同研发。经过多年科学技术研究的实践，在国内外材料科学技术领域中形成了自己的鲜明特色。科学研究工作的重点集中高效能源转换材料与器件、结构／功能一体化复合材料、生物医用与生命复合材料、信息功能材料与器件、材料复合新技术与复合原理等五个方向，推动武汉理工大学材料优势学科向质量提升为核心的内涵式发展，显著提升武汉理工大学材料学科的国际影响力和国际竞争力。

基地始终以国家社会经济的重大需求、人民生活的美好诉求为根本出发点，以双碳战略、长江经济带建设战略与一带一路战略等三大国家战略为轴心，强化国际科研交流合作，汇聚国际一流水平的学术团队，产生具有国际影响力的原创性研究成果，打造国际一流水平的建筑材料学科创新平台，引领国际建筑材料研究与应用技术发展；培养国际一流人才，构建卓越人才培养新体系，为建材行业发展和我国重大战略实施提供重要人才支撑；营造国际协同、校企合作、科技创新文化，加强和深化国际合作研究，不断增强基地的国际影响力。

Campus Life Art & Culture Sports & Facilities Students’ Associations Banking Campus Canteens Stores and Supermarkets Campus Accommodation Post Offices Hospitals Campus Bus Transportation
What is the most important thing in college students’ life? Apart from the romantically infused sight of cherry blossoms in spring and the wisdom imparted by teachers to the studious, commuting remains a common concern. Transportation is significant for a campus that covers 5915 acres , with teaching and living facilities scattered around. Thanks to the efforts of Wuhan University (WHU), several measures have been taken to improve students’ commute inside this large campus.
For most students, electric bicycles and school buses are the top two choices to cope with hilly streets and little travel time. However, electric bicycles are dangerous for drivers and school buses can be time-consuming. Improving measures related to these two means of transport have become one of the greatest concerns of the relevant university authorities, resulting in several changes.

Upon acceptance into the program, students will receive a room application form along with their admission documents. In order to apply for accommodation on-campus, students should follow the instructions provided on the form. Due to high demand and limited resources, room allocation is based on a “first come, first served” principle. Therefore, international students who plan to live on-campus are advised to apply for their room as soon as they receive their admission package.
The Renmin University of China provides two types of dormitory rooms to the international students:
Foreigners who need to stay in China after the expiration of residence permits shall apply for an extension 30 days before the expiration. housing_costs.value:
3. International students living in the Xianlin campus’s student dormitory should pay their room fees according to the stipulated time period. Rent may be paid by semester or by school year.
From Nanjing Lukou International Airport to Gulou campus (about 45 km) a. By Airport shuttle bus: Take bus line 1 to Nanjing Railway Station or take bus line 2 to Zhonghua Gate. It will cost you RMB 25. Then take a cab to the dormitory (for about RMB 22). b. By Taxi: It will cost you around RMB 150~200. c. By Subway:Take metro Airport Line(toward Nanjing South Railway Station) at Lukou Airport to Nanjing South Railway Station(7 stops). And then transfer Line 1 inside the station. Take metro line 1 (toward Maigao Qiao) to the Gulou station and then take the second exit. You may call a taxi (for about RMB 11) or take a 15-minute walk to the dormitory
From Nanjing Lukou International Airport to Xianlin campus (about 60 km) a. By Airport shuttle bus: Take bus line 1 to Nanjing Railway Station or take bus line 2 to Zhonghua Gate. It will cost you RMB 25. Then take a cab to the dormitory (for about RMB 50). b. By Taxi: It will cost you around RMB 150~200. c. By Subway:Take metro Airport Line(toward Nanjing South Railway Station) at Lukou Airport to Nanjing South Railway Station(7 stops). And then transfer Line 1 inside the station. Take metro line 1 (toward Maigao Qiao) to the Xinjiekou Station and then take metro line 2(toward Jingtian Street) inside the station. Take exit 1 at Nanjing University Xianlin Campus Station. You may take a 20-minute walk to the dormitory.
8. The students who have received Confucius Scholarship or Chinese Government Scholarship do not need to pay for the accommodation fee.

housing.value:
We’re proud to be able to provide accommodation to all undergraduate students who require it. All our undergraduate freshers (first-year students) are housed on our main college site, right in the heart of Oxford. You’ll be at the centre of our college community, close to the common room and dining hall, and living alongside other new students.
Graduate applicants who receive either a conditional or unconditional offer from Hertford are invited to apply for college accommodation via a separate application form sent by the Hertford Accommodation Office.
Application process Applications are processed in three allocation rounds (normally April, May and June). Following each round, applicants will either: receive an accommodation offer; or be notified that they remain under consideration for the next round. Applicants who are unsuccessful after the final round may join a waiting list. If you have a disability or medical requirement affecting accommodation, this must be declared in your application and registered with the University’s Disability Advisory Service (DAS) so that it can be prioritised during the allocation process.

Most universities operate their own dormitories. Dormitories are located on campus or within a relatively short distance, making them convenient for commuting and relatively affordable. Additionally, dormitories are equipped with various facilities such as libraries, computer labs, gyms, and dining halls, offering a range of conveniences for students. However, dormitories are shared living spaces, so privacy is limited, and strict living rules are enforced. Rooms are typically categorized into single, double, or quadruple occupancy. The conditions for admission and living costs vary by university, so it is recommended to inquire with your
											school’s dormitory office.

evidence.quote:
at least two years of university studies. It is entirely taught in English and offers approximately 15 courses per semester in the following fields : law/political science, business/business culture and humanities. The SELF will help students get familiar with the French University system and culture. It can also help them improve their proficiency so as to study in French the following semester (except for beginners). It is a full time program and cannot be combined with other programs.

Internationales Profil — Universität Bonn
de
en
Internationales Profil
Dank ihrer ausgezeichneten Reputation verfügt die Universität Bonn über ein renommiertes internationales Netzwerk sowie über intensive Lehr- und Forschungskooperationen weltweit. Sie genießt einen in ganz Deutschland einmaligen Standortvorteil. In der internationalen Bundesstadt Bonn und der umliegenden Region sind eine Vielzahl an UN-Einrichtungen sowie international ausgerichtete Wissenschafts- und Förderorganisationen angesiedelt. So bietet die regionale Verwurzelung der Universität Bonn ein Tor in die Welt, das die internationale Vernetzung der Universität nachhaltig stärkt.
© Volker Lannert
Strategie zur Internationalisierung 2030
Internationalisierung ist ein zentrales Element der Gesamtausrichtung und Entwicklungsplanung der Universität Bonn. Die Strategie treibt diesen Prozess voran und wird regelmäßig fortgeschrieben.

The University of Bonn is integrated in a considerable number of international networks. Maintaining excellent relations with internationally-renowned universities and research centers throughout the world, the University is a key actor in the transnational knowledge society. This is expressed further in the large number of international students attracted to the University of Bonn every year, the considerable international mobility of our students and sustained interest from visiting international researchers to work at the University of Bonn.

Global Exchange Program: Studying in Bonn for a semester or year
The Global Exchange Program opens a path for students at the University of Bonn’s partner universities outside Europe to study for a year or a semester at the University of Bonn. Nearly 100 different degree programs are offered, as well as a diverse range of courses to help program participants master the German language.
Program Objectives
The Global Exchange Program was founded to provide international students worldwide with the chance to spend a portion of their studies (one or two semesters) in Bonn. It offers students an unparalleled opportunity to expand their intercultural competencies while still studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree by integrating them into daily life at a German university and the larger German society. Application and Preparation — University of Bonn
de
en
Application and Preparation
You have decided to study in Bonn with the Global Exchange Program? Here you will find all the information and forms for your application as well as tips to prepare for your time studying abroad.
Who can apply?
To apply for the Global Exchange Program scheme, you must meet the following requirements:
You must be currently studying at one of the University of Bonn’s partner universities (your nationality is not important).
You are interested in studying at the University of Bonn for one or two semesters.
Bachelor’s degree students: you must have completed at least the first year of your degree program before you begin studying in Bonn.
Students can apply in any academic discipline (excepting medicine and dentistry). Candidates will be selected by their home universities based on a variety of criteria, including academic performance, interests, motivation and language skills.

交換留学においては、留学期間の属する年度の駒澤大学の学費が減免されることがあります。それだけでなく、ほとんどの派遣先大学での授業料は免除になります。何かと経済的な負担の大きい留学にとっては、大きなメリットと言えるでしょう。

University Housing offers graduate students the option to contract for housing on the main campus.
Housing contracts are available to students after they have been formally admitted to FSU. Admitted students can contract electronically by accessing our online contract . Students may also visit the Housing Office, located in the Student Life Center, and fill out a hard copy of the Housing Contract.

Understand Costs Beyond Rent: Be sure to clarify all fees, including application fees, administrative fees, security deposits, and parking fees. Ask which utilities are included and which you will be responsible for.
Tharpe: This area offers affordable housing and a quieter, residential feel. It can be a great fit for students who are proactive and prioritize a lower price point.

Each resident brings a different set of expectations. To encourage open communication, all residents discuss and sign a roommate agreement at the beginning of the fall term and any time there is a change in residence status in the room. When roommates are unable to resolve a situation on their own, a mediator is called upon to help. In mediation, an objective person, usually a University Housing staff member, acts as an arbitrator to ensure that strong feelings do not hinder the process and that roommates follow the rules. In the extreme cases in which mediation fails, arbitration will be used. In this process roommates agree beforehand to honor the arbitrator's decision. This binding decision may entail one or more roommates moving to another room. Students requesting to move to another room are obligated to their current room assignment until University Housing is able to find space available to accommodate the move.

housing.value:
CSULB's housing options offer students a convenient and supportive living environment. On-campus housing provides students with a sense of community and the opportunity to get involved in campus life. Living on campus can also help students feel more connected to the university and make it easier to access academic and other resources.
There are several different housing options available at Long Beach State University. Each option offers a different living experience and caters to different student needs and preferences.
Housing Room Rates are structured by three tiers, then by room types, based on buildings and amenities. Please be sure to check out our Room Comparison Chart (PDF) .
Step 2 - Begin housing application on the Housing Portal (accessible through your MyCSULB SSO) Application will take 15-20 minutes to complete. Due to high demand, the application portal may not be available on your first attempt. Since applications are based on distance, students can apply any date and time between April 2 and priority date of May 1st. If you are applying before May 1st, the application is not first-come, first serve . If you are experiencing portal issues, try again later.

Gender-Inclusive Housing is an option for students who would feel more comfortable living in a single room with a community restroom and shower that are designated as gender neutral.
Winona has a variety of rental options for college students, including studio apartments, apartment complexes, and rental houses. The Winona State Off-Campus Housing Marketplace is a great resource to find available rental units or subleases, connect with potential roommates, and buy or sell household items.
Whether you are new to WSU or a current student returning to the halls, the Housing & Residence Life office is happy to help you through the application process.
The cost for housing depends on the residence hall and room type you choose.

housing.value:
Study costs at Xiamen University are relatively low compared with most of the other major universities in China and beyond. A good variety of scholarships are available to international students, including Chinese Government Scholarships, Confucius Institute Headquarter/Hanban Scholarships, Fujian Provincial Government Scholarships, Xiamen Tan Kah Kee Scholarships and Xiamen University Scholarships. Full scholarships cover tuition, accommodation, living allowance and insurance costs, while partial scholarships cover one or several items under full scholarships.
VI. Accommodation Fee (utility charges not included)
Foreigners who need to stay in China after the expiration of residence permits shall apply for an extension 30 days before the expiration. Foreigners who hold a valid residence permit and have changed passports or had other items on the residence permit changed shall apply to the exit and entry administration authority of public security organs for information update within 10 days from the date the changes occur.
在大陆停居留的台湾居民应当按照《中国公民往来台湾地区管理办法》的规定办理住宿登记后申请办理台胞证。

地域連携 2026.04.13 留学生が一日警察署長として活躍　地域で交通安全を呼びかけ
4月7日、「春の全国交通安全運動出動式における広報啓発活動」が、道の駅みのりの郷 東金（千葉県東金市）で開催され、国際人文学部国際交流学科の留学生であるパトリシア ロンキエビチュさんが一日警察署長として交通事故防止に向けた注意喚起の広報活動や啓発物の配布を行いました。パトリシアさんは、ポーランド ワルシャワ大学からの交換留学生として本学で学んでおり、地域との交流や日本文化への関心の高さが評価され、このたび一日警察署長に任命されました。
委嘱式終了後は、道の駅みのりの郷 東金へ移動し、来店された方々に、終始笑顔で積極的に声をかけながら啓発物を手渡し、交通安全を呼びかけました。
*シャトルバスをご利用の方は、事前のご予約が必要になります。申込フォームで「交通手段：シャトルバス」を選んでいただくと、同伴者の人数も含めて自動的に予約されます。当日のご案内をスムーズにするため、交通手段の選択にご協力ください。

reference_excerpts.value: Promoting Exchange Programs for International Students in Meeting Their Educational and Career Goals Tsuda’s formal student exchange program started in 1978 with the signing of an exchange agreement with Bryn Mawr College. Since then, the University has established student exchange or visiting programs with 30 institutions abroad. We accept international exchange students either for one year (April to January or September to July) or for half a year (spring semester or fall semester), depending upon students’ preferences. The Center for International Exchange (CIE) provides many services to international students including advice on academic systems, registration for national health insurance, scholarship application, and orientations. The CIE helps assign campus accommodations for international students, and by collaborating with departments, faculties, and local communities, the CIE supports international students, including degree-seeking students, in order to enhance their educational, cultural, and social experiences so that they can make the most of their stay at Tsuda University.

housing.value:
Applications for UNSW owned and operated residential colleges and apartments are still being accepted, however vacancies are limited. There are also affiliated accommodation options available on campus. We are currently working to open more rooms on campus, and we encourage you to plan ahead and apply as early as possible.
To see what accommodation is available, compare fees and apply online, visit UNSW’s Accommodation page.
UNSW Off-Campus Accommodation Support (OCAS) team helps students find safe and affordable places to live near the university.
Budget options 💰 Looking to spend between $250–$450* per week on accommodation? Here’s where to look for low-cost living options. *Prices marked are calculated per person and might not be the total price for the entire property. Category Description Inclusions Provider Shared/community living Twin Rooms Only Companies offer a variety of rooms at different rates. Community living offers standard-style rooms with shared facilities, such as bathrooms, kitchen and living areas. Prices depend on room inclusions (e.g. private bathroom). Rooms vary in inclusions, furnished or unfurnished. Contact the provider for full details. Usually, an all-inclusive rate to include costs of utilities (e.g. water, gas, electricity). Usually furnished. Myola Coogee Muse Living Sweet Pea Living Down Under Stay Semester In Australia Shared flatmates Search Platform Rooms available to live with flatmates. Affordable, cost-sharing option ideal for budget-conscious renters. Do not choose this option if you are overseas. In Person inspections recommend. Various options to suit different budgets. Check property profiles for inclusions. Most are furnished. Utilities such as electricity, gas and Wi-Fi could be extra. Flatmates Flatmate Finders ZUWU Female Flatmates Female-only accommodation search platform offering safe and secure shared housing with like-minded female residents. A range of accommodation options to suit different budgets. Room features, furnishings and utilities vary by property. Refer to individual listings for full details. Sofeaa Study Stays Full variety of options available for all budgets. On average, rates can be cheaper found here. See individual accommodation listings on the website for full details. You can contact the accommodation providers directly after a quick registration as a UNSW student. UNSW Study Stays

reference_excerpts.value: Budget options 💰 Looking to spend between $250–$450* per week on accommodation? Here’s where to look for low-cost living options. *Prices marked are calculated per person and might not be the total price for the entire property. Category Description Inclusions Provider Shared/community living Twin Rooms Only Companies offer a variety of rooms at different rates. Community living offers standard-style rooms with shared facilities, such as bathrooms, kitchen and living areas. Prices depend on room inclusions (e.g. private bathroom). Rooms vary in inclusions, furnished or unfurnished. Contact the provider for full details. Usually, an all-inclusive rate to include costs of utilities (e.g. water, gas, electricity). Usually furnished. Myola Coogee Muse Living Sweet Pea Living Down Under Stay Semester In Australia Shared flatmates Search Platform Rooms available to live with flatmates. Affordable, cost-sharing option ideal for budget-conscious renters. Do not choose this option if you are overseas. In Person inspections recommend. Various options to suit different budgets. Check property profiles for inclusions. Most are furnished. Utilities such as electricity, gas and Wi-Fi could be extra. Flatmates Flatmate Finders ZUWU Female Flatmates Female-only accommodation search platform offering safe and secure shared housing with like-minded female residents. A range of accommodation options to suit different budgets. Room features, furnishings and utilities vary by property. Refer to individual listings for full details. Sofeaa Study Stays Full variety of options available for all budgets. On average, rates can be cheaper found here. See individual accommodation listings on the website for full details. You can contact the accommodation providers directly after a quick registration as a UNSW student. UNSW Study Stays

reference_excerpts.value: Budget options 💰 Looking to spend between $250–$450* per week on accommodation? Here’s where to look for low-cost living options. *Prices marked are calculated per person and might not be the total price for the entire property. Category Description Inclusions Provider Shared/community living Twin Rooms Only Companies offer a variety of rooms at different rates. Community living offers standard-style rooms with shared facilities, such as bathrooms, kitchen and living areas. Prices depend on room inclusions (e.g. private bathroom). Rooms vary in inclusions, furnished or unfurnished. Contact the provider for full details. Usually, an all-inclusive rate to include costs of utilities (e.g. water, gas, electricity). Usually furnished. Myola Coogee Muse Living Sweet Pea Living Down Under Stay Semester In Australia Shared flatmates Search Platform Rooms available to live with flatmates. Affordable, cost-sharing option ideal for budget-conscious renters. Do not choose this option if you are overseas. In Person inspections recommend. Various options to suit different budgets. Check property profiles for inclusions. Most are furnished. Utilities such as electricity, gas and Wi-Fi could be extra. Flatmates Flatmate Finders ZUWU Female Flatmates Female-only accommodation search platform offering safe and secure shared housing with like-minded female residents. A range of accommodation options to suit different budgets. Room features, furnishings and utilities vary by property. Refer to individual listings for full details. Sofeaa Study Stays Full variety of options available for all budgets. On average, rates can be cheaper found here. See individual accommodation listings on the website for full details. You can contact the accommodation providers directly after a quick registration as a UNSW student. UNSW Study Stays

An international university
Stockholm University works actively to increase international collaboration – a prerequisite for research and education of high quality.
Through alliances, partnerships and cooperation we collaborate with universities around the world.
This content can be loaded from a third party which uses cookies. If you want to view the video, you need to consent to cookies for videos by clicking here.
Through international collaboration within the research fields of environment and social and economic sustainability, Stockholm University contributes towards reaching the goals set by Agenda 2030 for tackling the global challenges facing society.
Stockholm University is ranked among the world’s top 100 universities, and is one of Europe’s leading institutes for higher education and research within both human science and science. Knowledge, enlightenment, truth seeking and critical thinking have been cornerstones since the University was founding in 1878.
In order to strengthen international academic collaboration, Stockholm University is working together with partner universities in several countries within the area

transport.value: Oklahoma City University recognizes its responsibilities as an educational institution to promote a productive student environment. This responsibility demands the implementation of programs and services that facilitate that effort. Federal law requires the establishment of anti-drug and alcohol programs that prohibit the use of illegal drugs and alcohol in or on University-owned or operated facilities. In order to meet these responsibilities and federal requirements, the University has established this Student Drug and Alcohol Abuse Policy, which is included in the OCU Student Handbook. I understand that Oklahoma City University has a Student Drug and Alcohol Abuse Policy. I further understand that the Vice President for Student Affairs is authorized to require those students whom he has reasonable grounds to believe are improperly using or possessing controlled substances in violation of the University's drug abuse policy to participate in the drug screening program. A student, who is convicted of a state or federal offense involving the possession or sale of an illegal drug that occurred while the student is enrolled in school and receiving Title IV aid, is not eligible for Title IV funds.

evidence.quote:
Elle accueille et accompagne les étudiants, enseignants, chercheurs et délégations venus de l'étranger.
Elle renseigne les étudiants de l'UMLP qui souhaitent effectuer une mobilité internationale dans le cadre d'un programme d'échanges ; elle les accompagne pour la définition de leur projet de mobilité.
Elle assure l'encadrement et le suivi des étudiants et des personnels sortants en amont, pendant et après la mobilité.
La DREIF assure également le versement des aides financières aux étudiants et personnels en mobilité encadrée.

DREIF | Université Marie & Louis Pasteur
Aller au contenu principal
La DREIF accompagne les membres de la communauté universitaire, étudiants et personnels, dans leurs projets internationaux et leurs projets de mobilités dans le cadre de partenariats répondant à la politique internationale de l'université.
Elle prospecte de nouveaux partenariats, impulse des dynamiques à l'international et favorise le développement de formations internationalisées.
Elle accueille et accompagne les étudiants, enseignants, chercheurs et délégations venus de l'étranger.
Elle renseigne les étudiants de l'UMLP qui souhaitent effectuer une mobilité internationale dans le cadre d'un programme d'échanges ; elle les accompagne pour la définition de leur projet de mobilité.
Elle assure l'encadrement et le suivi des étudiants et des personnels sortants en amont, pendant et après la mobilité.
La DREIF assure également le versement des aides financières aux étudiants et personnels en mobilité encadrée.

Doubles diplômes
Les diplômes en partenariat international (double diplôme, diplôme conjoint, master conjoint Erasmus Mundus, etc.) de niveau licence et master permettent aux étudiants de suivre une partie de leur formation dans un ou plusieurs établissements partenaires à l’étranger et d’obtenir à la fois le diplôme de l’Université Marie et Louis Pasteur et celui des partenaires.

housing_costs.value:
Chico State is one of the only residential campuses within the California State University (CSU) system. This means most of our students live on, or within walking or biking distance (2km), of campus. Chico’s cost of living is great too—housing rentals are on average 50% less than those in the San Francisco and Los Angeles regions of California.
Explore housing communities, compare room options, review costs, apply for housing, prepare for move in, access resources, and learn about living on campus.
Main Housing Office 530-898-6325 housing@csuchico.edu @chicostatehousing
Renter's Insurance Some housing providers may require renter's insurance and some may not. It is always recommended to have proper coverage in case the unexpected happens. Homeowner's Policy - Side Coverage - Some students may be covered under their parent's homeowners policy, however it is important not to just assume. If a parent wishes a student's rental to be covered it is important they contact their insurance agent. Car Insurance Policy - Bundles - Some insurance companies allow you to bundle services for a discount! If you already have coverage for a car, you can contact your agent and get quotes on adding a renter's policy to your account. Many times bundling services results in annual savings for a multiple policy account. Renter's Insurance Policy - Single: If the first two options aren't the right fit for you, there are many insurance companies that offer renter policies. A good place to start learning is to check out this article all about Renter's insurance from The Zebra and also this Forbes article about the importance of renter's insurance .

About West Campus Nord Avenue and its extension as Walnut Street form a natural "west campus" boundary for several neighborhoods west of the Union Pacific railroad tracks that have long been popular with college-aged renters. Rental prices are generally closer to north campus rates, and many businesses and services are located along Nord Avenue. Nord Avenue becomes Walnut Street, and vice versa, at West Sacramento Avenue.
The B-Line Bus, our local public bus system, provides free bus service to and from campus every 30 minutes on academic days.

reference_excerpts.value: University Housing Is University Housing the right choice for you? The following information can help you make this important decision. At Chico State, University Housing is most commonly selected by U.S. college students during their first year away from home - at age 18. All university residences are shared living spaces. Most students share a room with at least one other resident and all units (including single rooms) share a bathroom with at least one other individual. University Housing has rules of conduct, including a strict "no alcohol/drugs" policy and quiet hours. University housing offers simple living quarters.  Accommodations and furnishings are not new. Most university dwellings have carpeted flooring (common in the U.S.). Students are required to purchase their own bedding (pillows, blankets, sheets) and towels. Be sure to comparison shop! The rental fee for University Housing includes the following "extras" that might not be included in the price of private housing: heating/cooling, Internet, water/garbage, garden care, organized gatherings and events, and a live-in resident advisor. Some meals are also included, and University Village offers a pool. Important - before signing a lease with University Housing, please note the following: Your lease is a binding legal document.  If you move out before your contract ends, you will not receive a refund. No exceptions. University Village (UV) is the only residence hall that remains open during winter break. Your lease ends on the last day of the academic year.  You must move out on that date. Which residence hall is right for you? International students are welcome to request any of the residence halls listed on the University Housing website, however the following are the only options that offer residents access to a kitchen and University Village is the only option that stays open during winter break (Dec-Jan). University Village - apartment-style living with a shared kitchen Konkow Hall - traditional dormitory style living with a shared kitchen Learn more and apply here: Chico State University Housing

housing.value:
Kyungnam University provides a cosy dormitory for International students and also various facilities on campus.
The Hanma dormitory building consist of Hanma Residence Hall 1 for male students and Hanma Residence Hall 2, 3 for female students. Hall 1 and 2 are available to students from other regions and accommodate over 1,200 students. Two students at each residence hall share one room air-conditioned. Each building is equipped with a variety of modern facilities, furnished with fast food stores, lounges, seminar and conference rooms, showers and bathrooms, reading rooms, a language lab, a fitness room, laundry facilities, computer labs, and recreation areas such as game rooms and a billiard room. Students are encouraged to experience interactions with other students, respecting the privacy of others as well as learning autonomy while in the residence hall.

housing_costs.value:
Student Housing has started a waitlist for the 2026-2027 academic year. If you intend to live on campus, please log into the Student Housing Portal and add yourself to the waitlist. There is no fee to join the waitlist.
A one-time $15 optional Residence Hall Association fee is placed on all student resident accounts. The Residence Hall Association (RHA) is an organization of residents acting as agents of opportunity to promote a healthy academic and social environment while voicing the concerns of the community. RHA provides opportunities for development in leadership skills, interpersonal and intercultural growth. If you wish not to participate in this fee, you can opt-out via the Student Housing website. Students must opt-out no later than 30 days before check-in.
If a student wishes to request a cancelation of their housing contract, they must complete the "License Agreement Cancellation Form" found in the Student Housing Portal "Forms" menu. Students who do not initiate the cancellation process will remain bound by the Student Housing License Agreement and will be charged all housing fees for their assigned space during the entire contract period.
An automated email will be sent upon submission of this form. The housing application fee is non-refundable.

transport.value:
Step 4: After moving out, return all issued key cards, mail keys, and other physical keys to the Student Housing Office during business hours (Mon–Fri, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.).
All requests requiring review are evaluated by the Housing Release Board, and a written decision is typically sent to the student within 10 to 15 business days after the request has been reviewed. Students who submit a request by the deadline will be assigned to a specific meeting date and notified accordingly. As part of the request, students submit a written statement and any supporting documentation in advance of the meeting. Students may choose to attend the Housing Release Board meeting to provide additional context for their request, or have their documentation reviewed without being present. During the meeting, the Board reviews requests individually. Students who attend the meeting are seen on a first-come, first-served basis based on order of arrival, with each in-person review typically lasting approximately 20 minutes.

reference_excerpts.value: All requests requiring review are evaluated by the Housing Release Board, and a written decision is typically sent to the student within 10 to 15 business days after the request has been reviewed. Students who submit a request by the deadline will be assigned to a specific meeting date and notified accordingly. 									enrollment guide will be sent to your registered residence in Korea.

living_costs.value:
Most universities operate their own dormitories. Dormitories are located on campus or within a relatively short distance, making them convenient for commuting and relatively affordable. Additionally, dormitories are equipped with various facilities such as libraries, computer labs, gyms, and dining halls, offering a range of conveniences for students. However, dormitories are shared living spaces, so privacy is limited, and strict living rules are enforced. Rooms are typically categorized into single, double, or quadruple occupancy. The conditions for admission and living costs vary by university, so it is recommended to inquire with your
											school’s dormitory office.
Proof of financial stability (minimum monthly living expenses: 900,000 KRW x 6 months = approx. 5,400,000 KRW). Note: Those changing from study (D-2) to job-seeking (D-10) status for the first time are exempt from submitting proof of financial stability.

content_review.quote:
【開催報告】RIFAが交換留学生と「First Meeting」を開催 | 麗澤大学
お知らせ
国際交流・留学
イベント
2026.09.28
【開催報告】RIFAが交換留学生と「First Meeting」を開催
9月24日（木）、秋セメスターに本学で学ぶ海外提携校からの交換留学生と、麗澤国際交流親睦会（RIFA）の学生による「First Meeting」が開催されました。
RIFAは、Reitaku International Friendship Associationの略称で、留学生と麗澤大学生との交流を支える学生団体です。交換留学生の日本語学習や日常生活のサポートをはじめ、学生同士の交流を通じて、キャンパス内の国際交流を活性化する重要な役割を担っています。
今回開催された「First Meeting」は、今後RIFAのメンバーと交換留学生が取り組んでいく「Conversation Partnership」のスタートとなる顔合わせの場です。
Conversation Partnershipは、RIFAのメンバーと交換留学生がグループとなり、一緒に勉強したり、食事をしたり、時には学外へ出かけたりしながら交流を深める活動です。単に言語を教え合うだけでなく、互いの文化や考え方への理解を深め、学生同士のつながりを築いていくことを目的としており、RIFAの活動の中でも最も大切な取り組みとなっています。
当日は、開始直後は参加者にもやや緊張した様子が見られました。
河野 洋
国際交流副センター長からの歓迎の挨拶を皮切りにプログラムがスタートすると、自己紹介やアイスブレイクを通して徐々に会話が弾み、会場には笑顔が広がっていきました。
開会挨拶をする河野 洋国際交流副センター長
会の後半にはすっかり打ち解けた様子で会話を楽しむ姿が見られ、中には早速、次に一緒に食事をしたり出かけたりする約束をする学生たちの姿もありました。

RIFAの交流活動の様子は、本学WEBサイトで随時お伝えしていきます。

​【開催報告】秋セメスターの交換留学生歓迎会を開催
2026年9月15日（火）、秋セメスターから本学での留学生活をスタートさせる交換留学生を歓迎する「留学生歓迎懇親会」が開催されました。
本イベントは、国際交流センターと麗澤国際交流親睦会（RIFA）の学生が共催する大学の公式行事として、新たな環境で留学生活を始める学生たちを歓迎するとともに、つながりを築く機会として例年企画されています。この秋、本学では海外9つの提携校から7つの国籍、21名の交換留学生を新たに迎えました。
当日は、
徳永澄憲
学長から歓迎の言葉が贈られ、
田中俊弘
国際交流副センター長による乾杯のご発声で懇親会が始まりました。
歓迎の挨拶をする徳永学長
田中国際交流副センター長の発声で乾杯！
その後は和やかな雰囲気の中で歓談が行われ、留学生同士だけでなく、本学の学生や教職員とも交流を深めるひとときとなりました。​途中、グループに分かれて自己紹介の時間も設けられ、会場は大いに盛り上がりました。
交流会の様子
交流会の様子
交流会の様子
ノベルティグッズを手渡す渡邊信副学長
歓談の後には、歓迎の気持ちを込めて、
渡邊信
副学長から留学生一人ひとりに麗澤大学のノベルティグッズが手渡されました。
また、留学生を代表して、ククルスキ・オリヴィエル・アルカディウシュさん（フォンティス応用科学大学：オランダ）と、スムリコ・メリサさん（ヴッパータール大学：ドイツ）の2名の交換留学生がスピーチを行い、麗澤大学での学びや日本での生活への期待、これからの留学生活に向けた意気込みが語​られました。それぞれの前向きな言葉に、会場からは温かな拍手が送られました。
ククルスキ・オリヴィエル・アルカディウシュさん
スムリコ・メリサさん
閉会挨拶をする山下教授
キャンパスツアーの様子
最後は、国際交流センターの
山下美樹
教授から、これから始まる留学生活が実りあるものとなるよう激励の挨拶が贈られ​、閉会しました。会の終了後は、RIFAメンバーによるキャンパスツアーが行われ、歓迎会の熱気が冷めやらず話を続ける様子が見受けられました。
留学生の皆さんが麗澤大学で多くの仲間と出会い、様々な経験を重ねながら、実りある充実した留学生活を過ごすことができるよう、今後も国際交流センターは支援して参ります。

housing_costs.value:
Each year, the program offers 285 reduced-rate housing opportunities for selected students assigned to the North Village traditional residence halls (double-occupancy rooms only). The reduced rate applies to room rent only and does not include meal plan charges or any other housing-related fees.
This program is designed to help students who are entering a new lease agreement and need assistance with paying the security deposits and first month’s rent up to a maximum amount of $1500.00
The College Initiative is a partnership between Lutheran Social Services (LSS), CSUS and Sacramento County Office of Education (SCOE) serving student parents 18-24 years with dependent children, and who are housing insecure. Services include housing navigation support, rent subsidy, emergency grants, and educational and developmental support for the student parents' children. Please initiate your referral by completing the Student Parent Housing Interest Form and the Housing Navigator will contact you.
Make an appointment & arrive on time: Make sure to call ahead and schedule an appointment for a tour and stick to it. And arrive at least 10 minutes early. Promptness can be a good indicator of whether you can pay rent on time in the landlord’s eyes. Follow up: Following up can show the landlord that you are interested and remind them of who you are. Be presentable: There may be many people interested in the same complex or unit you may be interested in. Proper attire can help you stand out. Have money ready: Be prepared to put money down to hold a place if you find one that you like. However, make sure you get a receipt for the deposit and note whether it is refundable if you decide not to rent, or if the deposit will be applied toward the rent. Note: The average apartment in Sacramento starts at $1850 for a 1-bedroom apartment. Be prepared to have that along with money for a deposit, which typically equals one month’s rent. Start early: Get a jump on the search. Keep in mind that other people will be looking to rent as well so make sure to start looking early. If you are looking to rent in the fall, start looking towards the end of the spring semester.

亜細亜大学を選ぶ５つのポイント
全て開く
Point1 外国人留学生受入れ実績
1954年、日本の私立大学において、初めて一度に90人を超える外国人留学生の受入れを開始してから70年。外国人留学生受入れの実績を積み重ねてきました。親子三世代で本学に留学してくれる方々もいらっしゃいます。アジア地域を中心とした同窓生組織は、在学生の強い味方になってくれています。
Point2 外国人留学生入試の多様性
「渡日前入学」という言葉をご存じですか。亜細亜大学では、この言葉が周知される以前から「来日せずに入学できる試験制度」を設置しています。また、一部の学部では、「日本語」の筆記試験と面接だけで受験できる試験制度が設置されています。
Point3 日本語の授業が正規科目
全学部1年次には、日本語科目が正規科目（必修科目）となっています。卒業要件に含まれる重要な科目として位置づけられており、大学進学後の日本語能力の向上に大変役立っています。
Point4 留学生会でつながる
アジア地域を中心にさまざまな国・地域から集った外国人留学生。ともすればバラバラになりがちな

transport.value:
There are a few telecommunications companies in China. Each company has varying prices for the different packages available. You can sign up for a line at the official shops (营业厅) of these companies by bringing along your passport or identification documents. To ensure that you always have a working line, be sure to keep a positive balance in your account! Minhang Campus: 821 -829 Dongchuan Rd.(Opposite to the Campus Gate at the No.800 Dongchuan Rd.) 上海市闵行区东川路 821-829 号(交通大学东川路 800 号斜对面)
3. After registration, you would immediately get a Bank of China card (银行卡） and SJTU International Student ID（校园卡） . With this student ID card, you could: 1) for all study-related purposes including applying for elective courses, paying fees, enrollment, etc. 2) use the student information retrieval system to print out your score report after the final exams of each semester for free. 3) Apply for a “Library Card” at the school library. You should use the card according to the rules and regulations set by the school library. 4)Pay on-campus canteen dining fee and shuttle bus fee.
